# Synthetic ReaFIR profile

`reafir-synthetic-noise.b64` is an opaque VST2 state fixture generated by feeding
NumPy random noise (seed 123, 48 kHz, no microphone) into the official ReaPlugs
2.36 x64 ReaFIR, selecting Subtract, learning a noise profile in its native UI,
then disabling learning and capturing the state through the host protocol.

It contains only generated test noise statistics and effect settings, not a plugin
DLL, voice recording, licensed model, user project, credential or private data.
Tests restore it into a separately downloaded official plugin and verify matching
audio output and substantial noise reduction. Raw plugin state serializations may
change innocuous bytes when reopened; functional equivalence is the assertion.
